fields.label: How will technology help me in my personal life?
How will technology help me in my professional life?
Why is it important to learn about digital technology? What are the benefits of using computers and the Internet? What are the dangers or potential downsides? Give several examples.
What are you hoping to learn from this course? Do you have any questions about computers or technology?
Exercise 1: Observe the Randomness — what did you notice about how the AI's answers changed and stayed the same across your attempts?
Exercise 2: Find the Limits — what happened when you tried to get the AI to tell you something untrue? What inaccuracies or fabrications did you notice?
Exercise 3: Synthesize a Novel Idea — what did you ask the AI to come up with, and what did it produce?
Pick two of the features below and try each one with ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude. Check off the two you tried.
items: Image input: take a photo of something around you and ask the AI to explain or analyze it
Chat with a document: upload a PDF or your own notes and ask the AI to summarize it or quiz you on it
Voice mode: have a short spoken conversation and notice how it differs from typing
Custom assistant: create a simple Custom GPT, Gem, or Project with a saved role
fields.note: The page offers 4 options and asks students to try 2 of them; the audit's 'which two were tried' is captured by which items get checked, not a shorter list.

fields.label: Write a few sentences about what worked well, what surprised you, and where the AI got something wrong.

Describe one way you could use AI to help you learn a subject, and one way that would cross the line into cheating yourself.
